- `GREP_QV_CMD_RE` lookbehind `(?<![\w.\-])` deliberately ADMITS a `/`-prefixed match so path pins are visible; the explicit `path_pinned and cmd == "grep"` skip exempts pinned GNU grep while a pinned `ugrep` still flags (per plan §10 critic latitude — divergent rc by construction). `pgrep`/`foo-grep`/`x.grep` rejected by lookbehind.
- Flag-set parse handles combined (`-qvE`), reversed (`-vq`), separated (`-q -vE`), and long forms (`--quiet`/`--silent` + `--invert-match`, incl. `=`-suffixed); contiguous-option-run capture correctly prevents pipeline cross-combination (`grep -v x f | grep -q y f2` → 0).
- `git grep` carve-out via preceding-word regex (`(?<![\w.\-])git\s+$`); `mygit grep` correctly NOT exempt; `git -C x grep -qv` would flag (fails toward flagging — documented, zero live instances).
- Fence scan: only in-fence .md lines scanned; unterminated trailing fence scanned (fails toward checking); line-number arithmetic verified (`base_idx + first + 1`, confirmed by the SKILL.md:3 fixture and the 8548/9066 pre-fix reproduction). `.sh` whole-file logical lines via the shared `_iter_logical_shell_lines` (yields 0-based `(first, last, logical)` — confirmed at `workflow_lint.py:2443`).
